title: Canonical Governance State Vocabulary
description: Five-dimensional orthogonal governance state model for governed system instances. Instance-independent — schema is reusable; state is instance-specific.

entity_type.description: Structural classification of the entity. Determines which other dimensions are applicable.

lifecycle_state.description: Entity's position in its governed lifecycle. Authority: canonical lifecycle model.

qualification_state.description: Whether the entity has satisfied qualification requirements. Authority: qualification engine.

health_state.description: Observed operational health. Authority: evidence pipeline projection.

execution_policy.description: Permitted execution behavior. Authority: governance policy / Owner decision.

x-orthogonality-invariant: No dimension may be used as a proxy for another. No dimension silently derives authority from another.

x-conflation-rules.description: lifecycle_state must not be used as qualification_state
qualification_state must not imply execution permission
entity_type SYSTEM_COMPONENT or HISTORICAL_LINEAGE must have qualification_state N/A
entity_type SYSTEM_COMPONENT or HISTORICAL_LINEAGE must have execution_policy N/A
